title: Female Night Support Worker
description:
Female Night Support Worker

Join our new team in York - person-centred care that makes a real difference Are you passionate about supporting people to live life on their own terms? Would you enjoy flexible, fulfilling work where you can build meaningful relationships and truly understand the person you support? If so, we'd love to welcome you to Active Assistance, part of the UK's largest provider of complex care.

We are recruiting Female Support Worker due to a genuine occupational requirement of the persons we support therefore this role is exempt from the Equality Act 2010 Part Schedule 9. Please confirm your gender at birth.

About this role

In this role, you'll support one individual with complex needs as part of a consistent care team, with regular weekly shifts and rotas planned in advance. While the role is offered on a flexible zero-hours contract, the work is ongoing and typically provides a stable working pattern with the same client.

What you'll be doing:
- 12-hour waking night shifts (21:00 - 9:00)
- Delivering person-centred, one-to-one care
- Supporting with all aspects of daily living and personal care
- Providing specialist clinical support (full training provided)
- Preparing meals and supporting household routines
- Supporting the client to engage in outings hobbies and activities
- Building a strong, trusting relationship through consistent care
- Build positive working relationships, communicate openly and professionally, and contribute to a supportive and respectful team environment.
- Follow organisational policies, procedures, safeguarding requirements, and professional standards at all times.

Requirements
- Full UK manual drivers licence - to drive the clients vehicle
- Comfortable around animals
- Demonstrate a strong commitment to delivering high-quality, person-centred care and be willing to go the extra mile to support the people we care for.
- Reliable, consistent, and passionate about making a positive difference every day.
- Show genuine compassion and a natural desire to support, encourage, empower, and uplift others.
- Treat everyone with dignity, patience, understanding, and empathy, recognising each person as an individual.

Benefits
- Earn up to £14.50 per hour (depending on experience)
- Flexible zero hour contract
- Enjoy regular consistent work with rolling rota while making a real difference in someone's life.
- An additional 14.07% holiday pay on every hour worked.
- Full specialist training, shadow shifts, and ongoing support from your Care Manager
- Access to the Active Learning Hub - e-learning & in-person development
- Holiday pay, regular monthly rotas, and a Nest pension
- Be recognised through our Active Awards programme
- Refer a friend and earn up to £1,500
- A chance to build a meaningful career with the backing of a leading clinical and business team

What happens after you apply? Once you click apply, you'll be directed to a dedicated application page where you'll answer a few short screening questions and have the opportunity to book a convenient time slot for your interview.
